evidence.notes: Salesforce API 67 rejected DescribeSObjectResult.getFieldSets() in the exact compile oracle; the fixture covers the supported fieldSets property instead.

Direct Apex property access is the supported Salesforce API 67 path; the exact compile oracle rejects getFieldSets() and explicit Schema.SObjectTypeFieldSets or Schema.FieldSetMap declarations, so the source uses describe.fieldSets.getMap().

name: data-platform-schema-describe-fieldsets

source.content: @isTest private class SchemaDescribeFieldSetsFixtureTest { @isTest static void describesFieldSetMetadata() { Schema.DescribeSObjectResult describe = Account.SObjectType.getDescribe(); Map<String, Schema.FieldSet> mapped = describe.fieldSets.getMap(); System.assert(mapped.containsKey('Summary')); Schema.FieldSet summary = mapped.get('Summary'); System.assert(summary != null); System.assert(summary.equals(summary)); System.assert(!summary.equals(null)); System.assert(summary.hashCode() != 0); System.assert(summary.toString().contains('Summary')); System.assertEquals('Summary', summary.getName()); System.assertEquals(summary.getName(), summary.name); System.assertEquals(null, summary.getNameSpace()); System.assertEquals(null, summary.getNamespace()); System.assertEquals(summary.getNamespace(), summary.namespace); System.assertEquals('Summary Fields', summary.getLabel()); System.assertEquals(summary.getLabel(), summary.label); System.assertEquals('Fields shown on summary pages.', summary.getDescription()); System.assertEquals(summary.getDescription(), summary.description); System.assertEquals(Account.SObjectType, summary.getSObjectType()); System.assertEquals(summary.getSObjectType(), summary.sObjectType); List<Schema.FieldSetMember> members = summary.getFields(); System.assertEquals(members.size(), summary.fields.size()); System.assertEquals(2, members.size()); Schema.FieldSetMember nameMember = members.get(0); System.assert(nameMember.equals(nameMember)); System.assert(!nameMember.equals(null)); System.assert(nameMember.hashCode() != 0); System.assert(nameMember.toString().contains('Name')); System.assertEquals('Name', nameMember.getFieldPath()); System.assertEquals(nameMember.getFieldPath(), nameMember.fieldPath); System.assertEquals('Account Name', nameMember.getLabel()); System.assertEquals(nameMember.getLabel(), nameMember.label); System.assert(nameMember.getRequired()); System.assertEquals(nameMember.getRequired(), nameMember.required); System.assert(nameMember.getDBRequired()); System.assertEquals(nameMember.getDBRequired(), nameMember.dbRequired); System.assertEquals(Schema.DisplayType.STRING, nameMember.getType()); System.assertEquals(nameMember.getType(), nameMember.type); System.assertEquals('Name', nameMember.getSObjectField().getDescribe().getLocalName()); System.assertEquals(nameMember.getSObjectField(), nameMember.sObjectField); Schema.FieldSetMember ratingMember = members.get(1); System.assertEquals('Rating', ratingMember.getFieldPath()); System.assertEquals(ratingMember.getFieldPath(), ratingMember.fieldPath); System.assert(ratingMember.getLabel().endsWith('Rating')); System.assertEquals(ratingMember.getLabel(), ratingMember.label); System.assert(!ratingMember.getRequired()); System.assertEquals(ratingMember.getRequired(), ratingMember.required); System.assert(!ratingMember.getDBRequired()); System.assertEquals(ratingMember.getDBRequired(), ratingMember.dbRequired); System.assertEquals(Schema.DisplayType.PICKLIST, ratingMember.getType()); System.assertEquals(ratingMember.getType(), ratingMember.type); System.assert(ratingMember.getSObjectField().getDescribe().getLocalName().endsWith('Rating')); System.assertEquals(ratingMember.getSObjectField(), ratingMember.sObjectField); } }

notes: Hosted API 67 field-set witness using exact field paths and labels plus a stable local-name suffix across field-set projections.
